about: The first as-needed Zofran supply has no recorded stop date and precedes Cipramil by 28 days. Three later Zofran supplies fall within prescribed Cipramil cover.
Amitriptyline 50 mg a day is supplied for five months in the middle of a 14-month history, together with amiodarone (a medicine with a known risk of torsades de pointes) over the same period.
During the ondansetron supplies the amitriptyline dose is 25 mg daily. When it increases to 50 mg daily, the pharmacist confirms that the same-day ciprofloxacin was used only locally.
